title: Man in Yellow Bath
description: A muscular man sits in a large round copper tub filled with thick yellow liquid. His head is tilted up with eyes closed, yellow lines cover his body, and he holds a black book with both hands while yellow liquid drips from the stone walls and ceiling above.
